prompt: A high, fixed view from the corner of a small tiled bathroom ceiling looking down and slightly across at Brandon, who stands at the sink seen from behind and a little to the side, his right arm raised with a claw hammer held in his fist beside his own cheek, his eyes shut tight, his brows pulled together and his mouth clenched. The hammer has not touched him. The basin is stained, the grout is grey-brown, a plastic toothbrush mug sits crooked on a glass shelf, and a flaking window with frosted glass is above the bath. The only light is one flat white tube overhead, making the white tiles slightly green. Muted, washed-out colour with a faint grain. Thanks.
